Name: The New Invention
Description: D, and your old friend in a very high place.

Actions.Name: Flurry of Iron
Actions.Description: When you take this Hero Action, make an unarmed strike (+16 to hit) against an enemy within 15 feet. On a hit, deal 1d8+7 force damage for each point you beat their AC by (minimum of 1, maximum of 7).

Actions.Name: Molten Defense
Actions.Description: When you take this Hero Action, your speed becomes 0 and you and all allies within 5 feet of you gain immunity to all damage until the start of your next turn.
